About Our service

UpoharBD.com is a Bangladeshi online gift shop and we deliver gift in Bangladesh. Here you can order gifts and flowers online to be delivered to your friends, family and business clients in Bangladesh. We are here 24/7 to assist you to send gift to Bangladesh from Australia, Bangladesh, Canada, USA, UK, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, European and Middle Eastern countries. We deliver gifts to Dhaka, Chittagong, Sylhet and all other cities in Bangladesh. You can order cake, flower, food items and package gifts for birthday, anniversary, Eid, Ramadan, Valentine's Day, Mother's Day and all other special occasions.

Price shown for each gift item includes all service charges for gift deliveries in Dhaka. All gift delivery service accompanies a free greetings card, free five red roses and free gift wrapping to make each gift presentable. UpoharBD takes great pride in offering exclusive collection of birthday cakes and wedding cake. All cakes are freshly baked by bakery of your choice and it will be decorated with the wish that you will provide at checkout. Also you will select gift delivery date and time at checkout, rest assured that Upohar will deliver your present at any location in Bangladesh at that time.

We envy other gift services and we are always trying to be one step ahead. We understand your requirements and Upoharbd.com is making the difference by assisting new customers to learn how to place an order. We also offer the most extensive payment options so that you can place and pay for your order regardless your location, availability of credit card and access to payment facilities. UpoharBD is meeting the demand of current busy lifestyle by providing urgent gift and same day gift delivery service. Our vision is to be an integral part of online Bangladesh and we are always listening to our customers to improve service quality; this is a never ending process. Upohar BD is one of the best online gift shops in Bangladesh not only because our customers said so in hundreds of their review but also because of the unique features in this website.

You can choose gift from over 1700 gifts for Bangladesh and pay for your order in your preferred currency i.e. BDT, AUD, CAD, EURO, USD & UK£. Surely that can be enough to meet your need but we are eager to receive your wish list. We have a reliable, trustworthy and trained team of customer service and gift delivery team, which is the product of more than 9 years of gift delivery service experience in Bangladesh. Upohar's online order tracking and full order history will always give you a peace of mind about your gift order to Bangladesh.
